# QR Code generator (C++)

From Project Nayuki's QR Code generator library, release v1.8.0:
https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator (the `cpp/` files, unchanged).
MIT License, as stated at the top of both files.

Powergram uses it to draw the code for logging in with a QR code
(`src/core/QrCode.cpp`).
